units.source_text: 催马乐《葛城》全文：“闻道葛城寺，位在丰浦境。

en.t: The full text of the saibara song “Kazuraki” says: “I have heard of Kazuraki Temple, which stands within the bounds of Toyoura.

units.source_text: 寺前西角上，有个榎叶井。

en.t: At the western corner in front of the temple, there is a well called Enoki Leaf Well.

units.source_text: 白玉沉井中，水底深深隐。

en.t: A white jewel has sunk into the well, hidden deep beneath the water.

units.source_text: 此玉倘出世，国荣家富盛。”

en.t: If this jewel should come forth into the world, the country will flourish and families will grow rich and prosperous.”
This appears in the Shoku Nihongi.
